meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: Claude 搜 X/Twitter 时按固定规则来:给时效性查询加日期下限、限定可信账号、用 since:/from: 等操作符,拆成 2~3 次查询,并与网页搜索对照。结论附 x.com 链接。
howto.when: 当你提到“X search”“Twitter search”“x_search”等关键词,或想了解 X 上的说法时触发;需已连接 xAI 账号、x_search 工具可用。

howto.what_en: When searching X/Twitter, Claude follows fixed rules: date-bounds time-sensitive queries, scopes trusted accounts, uses since:/from: operators, splits into 2-3 searches, and checks results against web_search. Claims cite x.com URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention X search, Twitter search, x_search, or what people are saying on X. Works only when an xAI account is connected and the x_search tool is available.
